name: List.flatMap_subtype
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {p : α → Prop} {l : List { x // p x }} {f : { x // p x } → List β} {g : α → List β}, (∀ (x : α) (h : p x), f ⟨x, h⟩ = g x) → List.flatMap f l = List.flatMap g l.unattach

name: List.flatMap_toArray
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (f : α → Array β) (as : List α), Array.flatMap f as.toArray = (List.flatMap (fun a => (f a).toList) as).toArray

name: List.flatMap_toArray_cons
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (f : α → Array β) (a : α) (as : List α), Array.flatMap f (a :: as).toArray = f a ++ Array.flatMap f as.toArray

name: List.flatMap_unattach
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {P : α → Prop} {xs : List (Subtype P)} {f : α → List β}, List.flatMap f xs.unattach = List.flatMap (fun x => match x with | ⟨x, h⟩ => binderNameHint x f (binderNameHint h () (f (wfParam x)))) xs

name: List.flatMap_wfParam
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {xs : List α} {f : α → List β}, List.flatMap f (wfParam xs) = List.flatMap f xs.attach.unattach

name: List.flatten_append
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {L₁ L₂ : List (List α)}, (L₁ ++ L₂).flatten = L₁.flatten ++ L₂.flatten

name: List.flatten_concat
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {L : List (List α)} {l : List α}, (L ++ [l]).flatten = L.flatten ++ l

name: List.flatten_cons
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {L : List (List α)}, (l :: L).flatten = l ++ L.flatten

name: List.flatten_filter_ne_nil
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : DecidablePred fun l => l ≠ []] {L : List (List α)}, (List.filter (fun l => decide (l ≠ [])) L).flatten = L.flatten

name: List.flatten_filter_not_isEmpty
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {L : List (List α)}, (List.filter (fun l => !l.isEmpty) L).flatten = L.flatten

name: List.flatten_flatten
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {L : List (List (List α))}, L.flatten.flatten = (List.map List.flatten L).flatten

name: List.flatten_ne_nil_iff
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xss : List (List α)}, xss.flatten ≠ [] ↔ ∃ xs, xs ∈ xss ∧ xs ≠ []

name: List.flatten_nil
type: ∀ {α : Type u}, [].flatten = []

name: List.flatten_replicate_nil
type: ∀ {n : Nat} {α : Type u_1}, (List.replicate n []).flatten = []

name: List.flatten_replicate_replicate
type: ∀ {n m : Nat} {α : Type u_1} {a : α}, (List.replicate n (List.replicate m a)).flatten = List.replicate (n * m) a

name: List.flatten_replicate_singleton
type: ∀ {n : Nat} {α : Type u_1} {a : α}, (List.replicate n [a]).flatten = List.replicate n a

name: List.flatten_reverse
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {L : List (List α)}, L.reverse.flatten = (List.map List.reverse L).flatten.reverse

name: List.flatten_singleton
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α}, [l].flatten = l

name: List.flatten_sublist_iff
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {L : List (List α)} {l : List α}, L.flatten.Sublist l ↔ ∃ L', l = L'.flatten ∧ ∀ (i : Nat) (x : i < L.length), L[i].Sublist (L'[i]?.getD [])

name: List.foldl.induct_unfolding
type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (f : α → β → α) (motive : α → List β → α → Prop), (∀ (a : α), motive a [] a) → (∀ (a : α) (b : β) (l : List β), motive (f a b) l (List.foldl f (f a b) l) → motive a (b :: l) (List.foldl f (f a b) l)) → ∀ (init : α) (a : List β), motive init a (List.foldl f init a)

name: List.foldlM_append
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {f : β → α → m β} {b : β} {l l' : List α}, List.foldlM f b (l ++ l') = do let init ← List.foldlM f b l List.foldlM f init l'

name: List.foldlM_attachWith
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] {l : List α} {q : α → Prop} (H : ∀ (a : α), a ∈ l → q a) {f : β → { x // q x } → m β} {b : β}, List.foldlM f b (l.attachWith q H) = List.foldlM (fun b x => match x with | ⟨a, h⟩ => f b ⟨a, ⋯⟩) b l.attach

name: List.foldlM_cons
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} [inst : Monad m] {f : β → α → m β} {b : β} {a : α} {l : List α}, List.foldlM f b (a :: l) = do let init ← f b a List.foldlM f init l

name: List.foldlM_filter
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {p : α → Bool} {g : β → α → m β} {l : List α} {init : β}, List.foldlM g init (List.filter p l) = List.foldlM (fun x y => if p y = true then g x y else pure x) init l

name: List.foldlM_filterMap
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} {γ : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {f : α → Option β} {g : γ → β → m γ} {l : List α} {init : γ}, List.foldlM g init (List.filterMap f l) = List.foldlM (fun x y => match f y with | some b => g x b | none => pure x) init l

name: List.foldlM_map
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {β₁ : Type u_3} {β₂ : Type u_4} {α : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] {f : β₁ → β₂} {g : α → β₂ → m α} {l : List β₁} {init : α}, List.foldlM g init (List.map f l) = List.foldlM (fun x y => g x (f y)) init l

name: List.foldlM_nil
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} [inst : Monad m] {f : β → α → m β} {b : β}, List.foldlM f b [] = pure b

name: List.foldlM_pure
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {f : β → α → β} {b : β} {l : List α}, List.foldlM (fun x1 x2 => pure (f x1 x2)) b l = pure (List.foldl f b l)

name: List.foldlM_reverse
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] {l : List α} {f : β → α → m β} {b : β}, List.foldlM f b l.reverse = List.foldrM (fun x y => f y x) b l

name: List.foldlM_subtype
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] {p : α → Prop} {l : List { x // p x }} {f : β → { x // p x } → m β} {g : β → α → m β} {x : β}, (∀ (b : β) (x : α) (h : p x), f b ⟨x, h⟩ = g b x) → List.foldlM f x l = List.foldlM g x l.unattach

name: List.foldlM_toArray
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} [inst : Monad m] (f : β → α → m β) (init : β) (l : List α), Array.foldlM f init l.toArray = List.foldlM f init l

name: List.foldlM_toArray'
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_3} {stop : Nat} [inst : Monad m] (f : β → α → m β) (init : β) (l : List α), stop = l.toArray.size → Array.foldlM f init l.toArray 0 stop = List.foldlM f init l

name: List.foldlM_unattach
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] {P : α → Prop} {xs : List (Subtype P)} {f : β → α → m β} {init : β}, List.foldlM f init xs.unattach = List.foldlM (fun b x => match x with | ⟨x, h⟩ => binderNameHint b f (binderNameHint x (f b) (binderNameHint h () (f b (wfParam x))))) init xs

name: List.foldlM_wfParam
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] {xs : List α} {f : β → α → m β} {init : β}, List.foldlM f init (wfParam xs) = List.foldlM f init xs.attach.unattach

name: List.foldlRecOn_cons
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {b : β} {x : α} {l : List α} {motive : β → Sort u_3} {op : β → α → β} (hb : motive b) (hl : (b : β) → motive b → (a : α) → a ∈ x :: l → motive (op b a)), List.foldlRecOn (x :: l) op hb hl = List.foldlRecOn l op (hl b hb x ⋯) fun b c a m => hl b c a ⋯

name: List.foldlRecOn_nil
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {b : β} {motive : β → Sort u_3} {op : β → α → β} (hb : motive b) (hl : (b : β) → motive b → (a : α) → a ∈ [] → motive (op b a)), List.foldlRecOn [] op hb hl = hb

name: List.foldl_add_const
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {a b : Nat}, List.foldl (fun x x_1 => x + a) b l = b + a * l.length

name: List.foldl_append
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : β → α → β} {b : β} {l l' : List α}, List.foldl f b (l ++ l') = List.foldl f (List.foldl f b l) l'

name: List.foldl_assoc
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {op : α → α → α} [ha : Std.Associative op] {l : List α} {a₁ a₂ : α}, List.foldl op (op a₁ a₂) l = op a₁ (List.foldl op a₂ l)

name: List.foldl_attach
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {l : List α} {f : β → α → β} {b : β}, List.foldl (fun acc t => f acc t.val) b l.attach = List.foldl f b l

name: List.foldl_attachWith
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {l : List α} {q : α → Prop} (H : ∀ (a : α), a ∈ l → q a) {f : β → { x // q x } → β} {b : β}, List.foldl f b (l.attachWith q H) = List.foldl (fun b x => match x with | ⟨a, h⟩ => f b ⟨a, ⋯⟩) b l.attach

name: List.foldl_cons
type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {a : α} {l : List α} {f : β → α → β} {b : β}, List.foldl f b (a :: l) = List.foldl f (f b a) l

name: List.foldl_filter
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {p : α → Bool} {f : β → α → β} {l : List α} {init : β}, List.foldl f init (List.filter p l) = List.foldl (fun x y => if p y = true then f x y else x) init l

name: List.foldl_filterMap
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {f : α → Option β} {g : γ → β → γ} {l : List α} {init : γ}, List.foldl g init (List.filterMap f l) = List.foldl (fun x y => match f y with | some b => g x b | none => x) init l

name: List.foldl_flatMap
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {f : α → List β} {g : γ → β → γ} {l : List α} {init : γ}, List.foldl g init (List.flatMap f l) = List.foldl (fun acc x => List.foldl g acc (f x)) init l

name: List.foldl_flatten
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {f : β → α → β} {b : β} {L : List (List α)}, List.foldl f b L.flatten = List.foldl (fun b l => List.foldl f b l) b L

name: List.foldl_hom
type: ∀ {α₁ : Type u_1} {α₂ : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} (f : α₁ → α₂) {g₁ : α₁ → β → α₁} {g₂ : α₂ → β → α₂} {l : List β} {init : α₁}, (∀ (x : α₁) (y : β), g₂ (f x) y = f (g₁ x y)) → List.foldl g₂ (f init) l = f (List.foldl g₁ init l)

name: List.foldl_ite_left
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {P : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred P] {l : List α} {f : β → α → β} {init : β}, List.foldl (fun sofar a => if P a then f sofar a else sofar) init l = List.foldl f init (List.filter (fun b => decide (P b)) l)

name: List.foldl_ite_right
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {P : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred P] {l : List α} {f : β → α → β} {init : β}, List.foldl (fun sofar a => if P a then sofar else f sofar a) init l = List.foldl f init (List.filter (fun a => decide ¬P a) l)

name: List.foldl_map
type: ∀ {β₁ : Type u_1} {β₂ : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {f : β₁ → β₂} {g : α → β₂ → α} {l : List β₁} {init : α}, List.foldl g init (List.map f l) = List.foldl (fun x y => g x (f y)) init l

name: List.foldl_map_hom
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {g : α → β} {f : α → α → α} {f' : β → β → β} {a : α} {l : List α}, (∀ (x y : α), f' (g x) (g y) = g (f x y)) → List.foldl f' (g a) (List.map g l) = g (List.foldl f a l)

name: List.foldl_max
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Max α] [Std.IdempotentOp max] [Std.Associative max] {l : List α} {a : α}, List.foldl max a l = max a (l.max?.getD a)

name: List.foldl_min
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : Min α] [Std.IdempotentOp min] [Std.Associative min] {l : List α} {a : α}, List.foldl min a l = min a (l.min?.getD a)

name: List.foldl_nil
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → β → α} {b : α}, List.foldl f b [] = b

name: List.foldl_pmap
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {l : List α} {P : α → Prop} {f : (a : α) → P a → β} (H : ∀ (a : α), a ∈ l → P a) (g : γ → β → γ) (x : γ), List.foldl g x (List.pmap f l H) = List.foldl (fun acc a => g acc (f a.val ⋯)) x l.attach

name: List.foldl_rel
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {l : List α} {f : β → α → β} {g : γ → α → γ} {a : β} {b : γ} {r : β → γ → Prop}, r a b → (∀ (a : α), a ∈ l → ∀ (c : β) (c' : γ), r c c' → r (f c a) (g c' a)) → r (List.foldl (fun acc a => f acc a) a l) (List.foldl (fun acc a => g acc a) b l)

name: List.foldl_reverse
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {l : List α} {f : β → α → β} {b : β}, List.foldl f b l.reverse = List.foldr (fun x y => f y x) b l

name: List.foldl_subtype
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {p : α → Prop} {l : List { x // p x }} {f : β → { x // p x } → β} {g : β → α → β} {x : β}, (∀ (b : β) (x : α) (h : p x), f b ⟨x, h⟩ = g b x) → List.foldl f x l = List.foldl g x l.unattach

name: List.foldl_toArray
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} (f : β → α → β) (init : β) (l : List α), Array.foldl f init l.toArray = List.foldl f init l

name: List.foldl_toArray'
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {stop : Nat} (f : β → α → β) (init : β) (l : List α), stop = l.toArray.size → Array.foldl f init l.toArray 0 stop = List.foldl f init l

name: List.foldl_unattach
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {P : α → Prop} {xs : List (Subtype P)} {f : β → α → β} {x : β}, List.foldl f x xs.unattach = List.foldl (fun s x => match x with | ⟨x, h⟩ => binderNameHint s f (binderNameHint x (f s) (binderNameHint h () (f s (wfParam x))))) x xs

name: List.foldl_wfParam
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {xs : List α} {f : β → α → β} {x : β}, List.foldl f x (wfParam xs) = List.foldl f x xs.attach.unattach

name: List.foldrM_append
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {f : α → β → m β} {b : β} {l l' : List α}, List.foldrM f b (l ++ l') = do let init ← List.foldrM f b l' List.foldrM f init l

name: List.foldrM_attachWith
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {l : List α} {q : α → Prop} (H : ∀ (a : α), a ∈ l → q a) {f : { x // q x } → β → m β} {b : β}, List.foldrM f b (l.attachWith q H) = List.foldrM (fun a acc => f ⟨a.val, ⋯⟩ acc) b l.attach

name: List.foldrM_cons
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {a : α} {l : List α} {f : α → β → m β} {b : β}, List.foldrM f b (a :: l) = List.foldrM f b l >>= f a

name: List.foldrM_filter
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {p : α → Bool} {g : α → β → m β} {l : List α} {init : β}, List.foldrM g init (List.filter p l) = List.foldrM (fun x y => if p x = true then g x y else pure y) init l

name: List.foldrM_filterMap
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} {γ : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {f : α → Option β} {g : β → γ → m γ} {l : List α} {init : γ}, List.foldrM g init (List.filterMap f l) = List.foldrM (fun x y => match f x with | some b => g b y | none => pure y) init l

name: List.foldrM_map
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {β₁ : Type u_3} {β₂ : Type u_4} {α : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {f : β₁ → β₂} {g : β₂ → α → m α} {l : List β₁} {init : α}, List.foldrM g init (List.map f l) = List.foldrM (fun x y => g (f x) y) init l

name: List.foldrM_nil
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] {f : α → β → m β} {b : β}, List.foldrM f b [] = pure b

name: List.foldrM_pure
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {f : α → β → β} {b : β} {l : List α}, List.foldrM (fun x1 x2 => pure (f x1 x2)) b l = pure (List.foldr f b l)

name: List.foldrM_reverse
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] {l : List α} {f : α → β → m β} {b : β}, List.foldrM f b l.reverse = List.foldlM (fun x y => f y x) b l

name: List.foldrM_subtype
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {p : α → Prop} {l : List { x // p x }} {f : { x // p x } → β → m β} {g : α → β → m β} {x : β}, (∀ (x : α) (h : p x) (b : β), f ⟨x, h⟩ b = g x b) → List.foldrM f x l = List.foldrM g x l.unattach

name: List.foldrM_toArray
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] (f : α → β → m β) (init : β) (l : List α), Array.foldrM f init l.toArray = List.foldrM f init l

name: List.foldrM_toArray'
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} {start : Nat} [inst : Monad m] (f : α → β → m β) (init : β) (l : List α), start = l.toArray.size → Array.foldrM f init l.toArray start = List.foldrM f init l

name: List.foldrM_unattach
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {P : α → Prop} {xs : List (Subtype P)} {f : α → β → m β} {init : β}, List.foldrM f init xs.unattach = List.foldrM (fun x b => match x with | ⟨x, h⟩ => binderNameHint x f (binderNameHint h () (binderNameHint b (f x) (f (wfParam x) b)))) init xs

name: List.foldrM_wfParam
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {xs : List α} {f : α → β → m β} {init : β}, List.foldrM f init (wfParam xs) = List.foldrM f init xs.attach.unattach

name: List.foldrRecOn_cons
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {b : β} {x : α} {l : List α} {motive : β → Sort u_3} {op : α → β → β} (hb : motive b) (hl : (b : β) → motive b → (a : α) → a ∈ x :: l → motive (op a b)), List.foldrRecOn (x :: l) op hb hl = hl (List.foldr op b l) (List.foldrRecOn l op hb fun b c a m => hl b c a ⋯) x ⋯

name: List.foldrRecOn_nil
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {b : β} {motive : β → Sort u_3} {op : α → β → β} (hb : motive b) (hl : (b : β) → motive b → (a : α) → a ∈ [] → motive (op a b)), List.foldrRecOn [] op hb hl = hb

name: List.foldr_add_const
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {a b : Nat}, List.foldr (fun x x_1 => x_1 + a) b l = b + a * l.length

name: List.foldr_append

name: List.foldr_assoc
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {op : α → α → α} [ha : Std.Associative op] {l : List α} {a₁ a₂ : α}, List.foldr op (op a₁ a₂) l = op (List.foldr op a₁ l) a₂

name: List.foldr_attach
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {l : List α} {f : α → β → β} {b : β}, List.foldr (fun t acc => f t.val acc) b l.attach = List.foldr f b l

name: List.foldr_attachWith
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {l : List α} {q : α → Prop} (H : ∀ (a : α), a ∈ l → q a) {f : { x // q x } → β → β} {b : β}, List.foldr f b (l.attachWith q H) = List.foldr (fun a acc => f ⟨a.val, ⋯⟩ acc) b l.attach

name: List.foldr_cons
type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {a : α} {l : List α} {f : α → β → β} {b : β}, List.foldr f b (a :: l) = f a (List.foldr f b l)

name: List.foldr_cons_nil
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α}, List.foldr List.cons [] l = l

name: List.foldr_filter
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {p : α → Bool} {f : α → β → β} {l : List α} {init : β}, List.foldr f init (List.filter p l) = List.foldr (fun x y => if p x = true then f x y else y) init l

name: List.foldr_filterMap
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {f : α → Option β} {g : β → γ → γ} {l : List α} {init : γ}, List.foldr g init (List.filterMap f l) = List.foldr (fun x y => match f x with | some b => g b y | none => y) init l

name: List.foldr_flatMap
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {f : α → List β} {g : β → γ → γ} {l : List α} {init : γ}, List.foldr g init (List.flatMap f l) = List.foldr (fun x acc => List.foldr g acc (f x)) init l

name: List.foldr_flatten
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → β → β} {b : β} {L : List (List α)}, List.foldr f b L.flatten = List.foldr (fun l b => List.foldr f b l) b L

name: List.foldr_hom
type: ∀ {β₁ : Type u_1} {β₂ : Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} (f : β₁ → β₂) {g₁ : α → β₁ → β₁} {g₂ : α → β₂ → β₂} {l : List α} {init : β₁}, (∀ (x : α) (y : β₁), g₂ x (f y) = f (g₁ x y)) → List.foldr g₂ (f init) l = f (List.foldr g₁ init l)

name: List.foldr_map
type: ∀ {α₁ : Type u_1} {α₂ : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} {f : α₁ → α₂} {g : α₂ → β → β} {l : List α₁} {init : β}, List.foldr g init (List.map f l) = List.foldr (fun x y => g (f x) y) init l

name: List.foldr_map_hom
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {g : α → β} {f : α → α → α} {f' : β → β → β} {a : α} {l : List α}, (∀ (x y : α), f' (g x) (g y) = g (f x y)) → List.foldr f' (g a) (List.map g l) = g (List.foldr f a l)

name: List.foldr_nil
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {α_1 : Type u_2} {f : α → α_1 → α_1} {b : α_1}, List.foldr f b [] = b

name: List.foldr_pmap
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {l : List α} {P : α → Prop} {f : (a : α) → P a → β} (H : ∀ (a : α), a ∈ l → P a) (g : β → γ → γ) (x : γ), List.foldr g x (List.pmap f l H) = List.foldr (fun a acc => g (f a.val ⋯) acc) x l.attach

name: List.foldr_rel
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {γ : Type u_3} {l : List α} {f : α → β → β} {g : α → γ → γ} {a : β} {b : γ} {r : β → γ → Prop}, r a b → (∀ (a : α), a ∈ l → ∀ (c : β) (c' : γ), r c c' → r (f a c) (g a c')) → r (List.foldr (fun a acc => f a acc) a l) (List.foldr (fun a acc => g a acc) b l)

name: List.foldr_reverse
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {l : List α} {f : α → β → β} {b : β}, List.foldr f b l.reverse = List.foldl (fun x y => f y x) b l

name: List.foldr_subtype
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {p : α → Prop} {l : List { x // p x }} {f : { x // p x } → β → β} {g : α → β → β} {x : β}, (∀ (x : α) (h : p x) (b : β), f ⟨x, h⟩ b = g x b) → List.foldr f x l = List.foldr g x l.unattach

name: List.foldr_toArray
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} (f : α → β → β) (init : β) (l : List α), Array.foldr f init l.toArray = List.foldr f init l

name: List.foldr_toArray'
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {start : Nat} (f : α → β → β) (init : β) (l : List α), start = l.toArray.size → Array.foldr f init l.toArray start = List.foldr f init l

name: List.foldr_unattach
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {P : α → Prop} {xs : List (Subtype P)} {f : α → β → β} {x : β}, List.foldr f x xs.unattach = List.foldr (fun x s => match x with | ⟨x, h⟩ => binderNameHint x f (binderNameHint s (f x) (binderNameHint h () (f (wfParam x) s)))) x xs

name: List.foldr_wfParam
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {xs : List α} {f : α → β → β} {x : β}, List.foldr f x (wfParam xs) = List.foldr f x xs.attach.unattach

name: List.forIn'.loop.congr_simp
type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {m : Type v → Type w} [inst : Monad m] (as : List α) (f f_1 : (a : α) → a ∈ as → β → m (ForInStep β)), f = f_1 → ∀ (as' as'_1 : List α) (e_as' : as' = as'_1) (b b_1 : β), b = b_1 → ∀ (a : ∃ bs, bs ++ as' = as), List.forIn'.loop as f as' b a = List.forIn'.loop as f_1 as'_1 b_1 ⋯

name: List.forIn'_congr
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] {as bs : List α} (w : as = bs) {b b' : β}, b = b' → ∀ {f : (a' : α) → a' ∈ as → β → m (ForInStep β)} {g : (a' : α) → a' ∈ bs → β → m (ForInStep β)}, (∀ (a : α) (m_1 : a ∈ bs) (b : β), f a ⋯ b = g a m_1 b) → forIn' as b f = forIn' bs b' g

name: List.forIn'_cons
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] {a : α} {as : List α} (f : (a' : α) → a' ∈ a :: as → β → m (ForInStep β)) (b : β), forIn' (a :: as) b f = do let x ← f a ⋯ b match x with | ForInStep.done b => pure b | ForInStep.yield b => forIn' as b fun a' m b => f a' ⋯ b

name: List.forIn'_loop_congr
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} {xs : List α} [inst : Monad m] {as bs : List α} {f : (a' : α) → a' ∈ as → β → m (ForInStep β)} {g : (a' : α) → a' ∈ bs → β → m (ForInStep β)} {b : β} (ha : ∃ ys, ys ++ xs = as) (hb : ∃ ys, ys ++ xs = bs), (∀ (a : α) (m_1 : a ∈ as) (m' : a ∈ bs) (b : β), f a m_1 b = g a m' b) → List.forIn'.loop as f xs b ha = List.forIn'.loop bs g xs b hb

name: List.forIn'_loop_toArray
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] (l : List α) (f : (a : α) → a ∈ l.toArray → β → m (ForInStep β)) (i : Nat) (h : i ≤ l.length) (b : β), Array.forIn'.loop l.toArray f i h b = forIn' (List.drop (l.length - i) l) b fun a m b => f a ⋯ b

name: List.forIn'_map
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} {γ : Type u_1} {init : γ} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {l : List α} (g : α → β) (f : (b : β) → b ∈ List.map g l → γ → m (ForInStep γ)), forIn' (List.map g l) init f = forIn' l init fun a h y => f (g a) ⋯ y

name: List.forIn'_nil
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] {f : (a : α) → a ∈ [] → β → m (ForInStep β)} {b : β}, forIn' [] b f = pure b

name: List.forIn'_toArray
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] (l : List α) (b : β) (f : (a : α) → a ∈ l.toArray → β → m (ForInStep β)), forIn' l.toArray b f = forIn' l b fun a m b => f a ⋯ b

name: List.forIn_cons
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] (f : α → β → m (ForInStep β)) (a : α) (as : List α) (b : β), forIn (a :: as) b f = do let x ← f a b match x with | ForInStep.done b => pure b | ForInStep.yield b => forIn as b f

name: List.forIn_map
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} {γ : Type u_1} {init : γ} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {l : List α} {g : α → β} {f : β → γ → m (ForInStep γ)}, forIn (List.map g l) init f = forIn l init fun a y => f (g a) y

name: List.forIn_nil
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] {f : α → β → m (ForInStep β)} {b : β}, forIn [] b f = pure b

name: List.forIn_toArray
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_1} [inst : Monad m] (l : List α) (b : β) (f : α → β → m (ForInStep β)), forIn l.toArray b f = forIn l b f

name: List.forM_append
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {l₁ l₂ : List α} {f : α → m PUnit}, forM (l₁ ++ l₂) f = do forM l₁ f forM l₂ f

name: List.forM_cons
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} [inst : Monad m] {f : α → m PUnit} {a : α} {as : List α}, forM (a :: as) f = do f a forM as f

name: List.forM_map
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {β : Type u_4} [inst : Monad m] [LawfulMonad m] {l : List α} {g : α → β} {f : β → m PUnit}, forM (List.map g l) f = forM l fun a => f (g a)

name: List.forM_nil
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} [inst : Monad m] {f : α → m PUnit}, forM [] f = pure PUnit.unit

name: List.forM_toArray
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} [inst : Monad m] (l : List α) (f : α → m PUnit), forM l.toArray f = l.forM f

name: List.forM_toArray'
type: ∀ {m : Type u_1 → Type u_2} {α : Type u_3} {stop : Nat} [inst : Monad m] (l : List α) (f : α → m PUnit), stop = l.toArray.size → Array.forM f l.toArray 0 stop = l.forM f

name: List.forall_mem_append
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} {l₁ l₂ : List α}, (∀ (x : α), x ∈ l₁ ++ l₂ → p x) ↔ (∀ (x : α), x ∈ l₁ → p x) ∧ ∀ (x : α), x ∈ l₂ → p x

name: List.forall_mem_cons
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} {a : α} {l : List α}, (∀ (x : α), x ∈ a :: l → p x) ↔ p a ∧ ∀ (x : α), x ∈ l → p x

name: List.forall_mem_filter
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {p : α → Bool} {P : α → Prop}, (∀ (i : α), i ∈ List.filter p l → P i) ↔ ∀ (j : α), j ∈ l → p j = true → P j

name: List.forall_mem_filterMap
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → Option β} {l : List α} {P : β → Prop}, (∀ (i : β), i ∈ List.filterMap f l → P i) ↔ ∀ (j : α), j ∈ l → ∀ (b : β), f j = some b → P b

name: List.forall_mem_flatMap
type: ∀ {β : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} {p : β → Prop} {l : List α} {f : α → List β}, (∀ (x : β), x ∈ List.flatMap f l → p x) ↔ ∀ (a : α), a ∈ l → ∀ (b : β), b ∈ f a → p b

name: List.forall_mem_flatten
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} {L : List (List α)}, (∀ (x : α), x ∈ L.flatten → p x) ↔ ∀ (l : List α), l ∈ L → ∀ (x : α), x ∈ l → p x

name: List.forall_mem_iff_forall_getElem
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {P : α → Prop} {l : List α}, (∀ (x : α), x ∈ l → P x) ↔ ∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < l.length), P l[i]

name: List.forall_mem_map
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → β} {l : List α} {P : β → Prop}, (∀ (i : β), i ∈ List.map f l → P i) ↔ ∀ (j : α), j ∈ l → P (f j)

name: List.forall_mem_ne
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (∀ (a' : α), a' ∈ l → ¬a = a') ↔ ¬a ∈ l

name: List.forall_mem_ne'
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (∀ (a' : α), a' ∈ l → ¬a' = a) ↔ ¬a ∈ l

name: List.forall_mem_nil
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} (p : α → Prop) (x : α), x ∈ [] → p x

name: List.forall_mem_replicate
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} {a : α} {n : Nat}, (∀ (b : α), b ∈ List.replicate n a → p b) ↔ n = 0 ∨ p a

name: List.forall_mem_singleton
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} {a : α}, (∀ (x : α), x ∈ [a] → p x) ↔ p a

name: List.fst_mem_of_mem_zipIdx
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {x : α × Nat} {l : List α} {k : Nat}, x ∈ l.zipIdx k → x.fst ∈ l

name: List.getElem!_cons_zero
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} [inst : Inhabited α] {l : List α}, (a :: l)[0]! = a

name: List.getElem?_append

name: List.getElem?_append_left
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l₁ l₂ : List α} {i : Nat}, i < l₁.length → (l₁ ++ l₂)[i]? = l₁[i]?

name: List.getElem?_append_right
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l₁ l₂ : List α} {i : Nat}, l₁.length ≤ i → (l₁ ++ l₂)[i]? = l₂[i - l₁.length]?

name: List.getElem?_attach
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs : List α} {i : Nat}, xs.attach[i]? = Option.pmap Subtype.mk xs[i]? ⋯

name: List.getElem?_attachWith
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {xs : List α} {i : Nat} {P : α → Prop} {H : ∀ (a : α), a ∈ xs → P a}, (xs.attachWith P H)[i]? = Option.pmap Subtype.mk xs[i]? ⋯

name: List.getElem?_concat_length
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {a : α}, (l ++ [a])[l.length]? = some a

name: List.getElem?_cons_succ
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {i : Nat} {l : List α}, (a :: l)[i + 1]? = l[i]?

name: List.getElem?_cons_zero
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {a : α} {l : List α}, (a :: l)[0]? = some a

name: List.getElem?_dropLast

type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] [inst_1 : LawfulBEq α] {l : List α} {a : α} {i : Nat}, (List.insert a l)[i]? = if a ∈ l then l[i]? else if i = 0 then some a else l[i - 1]?

name: List.getElem?_insertIdx
type: ∀ {α : Type u} {l : List α} {x : α} {i j : Nat}, (l.insertIdx i x)[j]? = if j < i then l[j]? else if j = i then if j ≤ l.length then some x else none else l[j - 1]?

type: ∀ {α : Type u} {l : List α} {x : α} {i j : Nat}, i < j → (l.insertIdx i x)[j]? = l[j - 1]?

name: List.getElem?_insertIdx_of_lt
type: ∀ {α : Type u} {l : List α} {x : α} {i j : Nat}, j < i → (l.insertIdx i x)[j]? = l[j]?

name: List.getElem?_insertIdx_self

name: List.getElem?_insert_succ
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] [inst_1 : LawfulBEq α] {l : List α} {a : α} {i : Nat}, (List.insert a l)[i + 1]? = if a ∈ l then l[i + 1]? else l[i]?

name: List.getElem?_insert_zero
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : BEq α] [inst_1 : LawfulBEq α] {l : List α} {a : α}, (List.insert a l)[0]? = if a ∈ l then l[0]? else some a

name: List.getElem?_intersperse

name: List.getElem?_intersperse_two_mul
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {sep : α} {i : Nat}, (List.intersperse sep l)[2 * i]? = l[i]?

type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {l : List α} {sep : α} {i : Nat}, i + 1 < l.length → (List.intersperse sep l)[2 * i + 1]? = some sep

name: List.getElem?_map
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {f : α → β} {l : List α} {i : Nat}, (List.map f l)[i]? = Option.map f l[i]?

name: List.getElem?_mapFinIdx
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {l : List α} {f : (i : Nat) → α → i < l.length → β} {i : Nat}, (l.mapFinIdx f)[i]? = l[i]?.pbind fun x m => some (f i x ⋯)

name: List.getElem?_mapIdx
